title: Export independently verifiable audit evidence
goal: Provide redacted exports with chain anchors, signature metadata, and a verification command; truncation, tampering, missing segments, and unknown keys produce distinct failures without exposing secrets. Deps (vectors): VC-201-004, VC-201-071, VC-201-072. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_079_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
